title: RecordedSession
description: session.json of a recorded session folder (samples/README.md). One real capture of one physical unit. No product facts beyond what the operator recorded; never a product name in an id. $defs/truth validates truth.json (the expected outcomes).

product.description: The design id of the product (the design engine's project) the scan is judged against; printed on the product or typed. Data, never code (GEN1).

make_model.description: As the operator typed it. Data, never code (GEN1).

source.description: gateway: written by the backend as it received the upload; phone_export: the app (A4); converter: an importer (B12).

split.description: Written by eval/assign_split.py. heldout sessions are read only by the evaluation.

truth.description: Expected outcomes, written by the person who induced (or ruled out) the faults on the real unit.

not_inspected_expected.description: Subjects the capture cannot see; RepairOS should report them not_inspected (I3).

negatives.description: True when the unit has no induced fault: every non-ok finding is a false alarm.
